description: Source code for the ACodecBufferChannel class, part of Android's media framework, handling buffer management, encryption, and descrambling for media codecs.

classes.name: ACodecBufferChannel::BufferInfo
classes.description: Represents buffer information including client buffer, codec buffer, buffer ID, and shared encrypted buffer.

classes.name: ACodecBufferChannel
classes.description: Manages media buffers, encryption, and descrambling for Android media codecs.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::~ACodecBufferChannel
methods.description: Destructor that unsets heap in crypto if applicable.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::queueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for processing.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::queueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with encryption or descrambling.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::attachBuffer
methods.description: Attaches a C2Buffer to a MediaCodecBuffer.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::attachEncryptedBuffer
methods.description: Attaches an encrypted buffer, handling decryption and descrambling.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::renderOutputBuffer
methods.description: Marks an output buffer as rendered.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::discardBuffer
methods.description: Discards a buffer, marking it as discarded.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::fillThisBuffer
methods.description: Indicates a buffer is ready to be filled.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::drainThisBuffer
methods.description: Indicates a buffer has been drained and is ready for output.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::setInputBufferArray
methods.description: Sets the array of input buffers.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::setOutputBufferArray
methods.description: Sets the array of output buffers.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::makeMemoryDealer
methods.description: Creates a MemoryDealer for buffer memory management.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::getInputBufferArray
methods.description: Retrieves the current input buffer array.

methods.name: ACodecBufferChannel::getOutputBufferArray
methods.description: Retrieves the current output buffer array.
